verses.text: Yahweh reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.
lines: Yahweh reigns! Let the peoples tremble.
He sits enthroned among the cherubim.
Let the earth be moved.

verses.text: Yahweh is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.
lines: Yahweh is great in Zion.
He is high above all the peoples.

verses.text: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!
lines: Let them praise your great and awesome name.
He is Holy!

verses.text: The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.
lines: The King’s strength also loves justice.
You establish equity.
You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.

verses.text: Exalt Yahweh our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!
lines: Exalt Yahweh our God.
Worship at his footstool.
He is Holy!

verses.text: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on Yahweh, and he answered them.
lines: Moses and Aaron were among his priests,
Samuel was among those who call on his name.
They called on Yahweh, and he answered them.

verses.text: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.
lines: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud.
They kept his testimonies,
the statute that he gave them.

verses.text: You answered them, Yahweh our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.
lines: You answered them, Yahweh our God.
You are a God who forgave them,
although you took vengeance for their doings.

verses.text: Exalt Yahweh, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for Yahweh, our God, is holy!
lines: Exalt Yahweh, our God.
Worship at his holy hill,
for Yahweh, our God, is holy!
